name: innovexa-platform
description: Innovexa Digital Management Platform — Admin, Partner and Client portals

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @innovexa/api" "npm run dev -w @innovexa/web"
scripts.dev:all: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n db,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev:db -w @innovexa/api" "npm run dev -w @innovexa/api" "npm run dev -w @innovexa/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @innovexa/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @innovexa/web
scripts.start: npm run build && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run start -w @innovexa/api" "npm run preview -w @innovexa/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.seed: npm run build:shared && npm run seed -w @innovexa/api
scripts.seed:admin: npm run build:shared && npm run seed:admin -w @innovexa/api --
